Brochures introducing Petra and its various monuments are available at the Visitor Center in Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Romanian, German and Italian. Various maps of Petra, including an aerial view map and a physical relief of the area, can also be obtained from the Visitor Center. Licensed tour guides can be booked from the Visitor Center to take you through the site. Our guides speak Arabic, English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Russian, Dutch, Hebrew and Greek. © 2024 PDTRA.
